title: Find Slope from Graphs Core Test
description: Find slope on coordinate graphs by using rise over run between two points on a line.

questions.questionText: On a coordinate graph, a line passes through (-6, -20) and (-4, -14). What is the slope?
questions.explanation: Use slope = change in y divided by change in x between the two graph points.

questions.questionText: A graphed line contains the points (-4, -4) and (8, 5). What is rise over run?
questions.explanation: Use slope = change in y divided by change in x between the two graph points.
